 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
ON THE 8 th OF AUGUST, 2025  MISC. CIVIL CASE No. 1316 of 2025  SMT. SEEMA AND OTHERS  Versus  SANTOSH KUMAR AND OTHERS  Appearance:
 Ms. Dhyoma Prajapati, learned counsel for the petit  ORDER

The present MCC has been filed for order in view of the fact that earlier MA No.1620/2021 was dismissed for non-compliance of the peremptory order dated 21.09.2021, which was restored vide order dated 04.04.2022 passed in MCC No.202/2022 granting 4 weeks' time for curing the defects with a stipulation that if the defects are not cured the order would automatically come to an end.
As the defects could not be cured, the effect of the order passed in MCC No.202/2022 came to an end and resultantly, MA No.1620/2020 could not be restored.
2. The applicant in the present MCC submits that the defect was of not paying the court fees.

It has been submitted that the issue relates to compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act and the financial situation of the applicants was such that they were not able to arrange the court fees, for that reason the defects could not be cured in time.

3. Considering the submission and looking to the fact that the case relates NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21380 2 MCC-1316-2025 to compensation for the death of family member,
I.A. No.4478/2025 as well as the present MCC for restoration of MA No.1620/2020 are allowed.
Applicants are granted further 8 weeks' time for furnishing the court fees.
4. With the aforesaid, the present MCC stands disposed of.

(PAVAN KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE N.R.
